title: ChronoMem public release manifest
description: Every figure the public page shows comes from here, so the page cannot state a number the repository cannot reproduce at the recorded commit.

result.description: One registered, one-shot comparison. Both baselines were run on the same questions in the same protocol.

significant_vs_naive_rag.description: Whether the headline gap cleared significance on this test. The page must state this alongside the gap.

tests.description: Automated tests of the code, passed plus skipped. Schema 1 also counted one case per tracked Markdown document here, so the figure moved when documents were committed; those are `document_checks` from schema 2 on, and the two numbers are not comparable across the version.

document_checks.description: Tracked Markdown documents the suite renders and checks. Reported apart from `tests` because it counts what is in the repository, not what is checked about the code.

measured_tree_sha256.description: sha256 over the files that decide these figures (src, tests, pyproject), name and bytes per file. Content-addressed rather than a commit SHA: a commit recorded in this file stops being reachable the moment the commit containing this file is amended, squashed or rebased. Recomputed by public-demo/check_release_figures.py.

source_commit_for_reference.description: The commit checked out when the figures were taken. A human pointer only; it may not survive a history rewrite, which is why it is not the record of record.
